steps: Clicked through the hosted app (test wallet 8WVm…): filled Create Poll and pressed Submit, which sent register_user + create_poll in one tx
Then moved the estimate slider on the new poll card and pressed Submit Estimate: make_estimate
register_user (mints 1000 POEKEN to the new user)
evidence.functional_evidence: Create poll, register_user and make_estimate all landed on devnet (script and UI). Resolving polls was not exercised, but is not a recorded failing path.
evidence.ui_check: Driven in headless Chromium with an injected Wallet Standard test wallet (tests/devnet/wallet_click.py, log tests/devnet/logs/ui-clicks-2026-11-10.jsonl): the new poll card then showed 'Yes 60%, 1 forecaster, 1 estimate' read back from devnet. Earlier read-only check: /poll/?id=0 shows the poll detail and estimate history.

limitations: Resolving polls and collecting points need the poll's resolver; not exercised in this run.
